description: Source code for WriteAheadLogBackedBlockRDD class and related classes, implementing a specialized RDD for reading data backed by write-ahead logs and block manager in Spark Streaming.

classes.name: WriteAheadLogBackedBlockRDDPartition
classes.description: Partition class containing block id, validity, and WAL record handle for the RDD partition.

classes.name: WriteAheadLogBackedBlockRDD
classes.description: RDD class that reads data from block manager or write-ahead logs, with options to store in block manager.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Returns array of partitions with block ids and WAL handles.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Retrieves data for a partition either from block manager or WAL, deserializes, and optionally stores in block manager.

methods.name: getPreferredLocations
methods.description: Returns preferred locations for a partition based on block location or WAL segment in HDFS.
